data.title: Ozone1 Residence
data.about:
Discover the allure of Ozone 1 Residence, offering apartments for sale in the vibrant community of JVC. Nestled in the heart of New Dubai, Ozone 1 Residences present an oasis of tranquility amidst the bustling cityscape. Explore our location map to find your way to this prestigious address in Jumeirah Village Circle.

Ozone 1 JVC boasts a 25-story architectural marvel, featuring fully furnished apartments designed for modern living. From cozy studios to spacious 1 & 2-bedroom apartments, each unit is adorned with premium European furnishings and appliances. Explore the Ozone 1 JVC floor plans to below envision your dream home.

Immerse yourself in the epitome of self-care at Ozone 1. Enjoy a refreshing dip in the swimming pool or rejuvenate body and mind at the yoga studio. State-of-the-art air-conditioning and air purification systems ensure a pristine living environment. Delve into Ozone 1 JVC reviews to discover why it's the perfect choice for discerning residents.

Conveniently located in Jumeirah Village Circle, Ozone 1 offers seamless connectivity to the city via three major highways. Experience the perfect balance of accessibility and tranquility. Explore Ozone 1 JVC price options to secure your slice of urban paradise.

characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Premier Location: Situated in District 13 of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Ozone 1 offers unmatched urban connectivity and access to a vibrant lifestyle.

location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Discover the allure of Ozone 1 Residence, nestled in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), a locality revered by investors and homeowners alike for its strategic positioning and vibrant community. Ozone 1 stands as a beacon of luxury and convenience, seamlessly connected to Dubai's principal regions via the Al Khail, Hessa, and MBZ Roads. This coveted development is not just about the elegant apartments for sale; it's about a lifestyle that blends comfort with convenience. Within a stone's throw, you'll find an array of amenities such as supermarkets, lush parks, gourmet restaurants, state-of-the-art fitness centers, and sparkling swimming pools. JVC elevates family living with its serene ambiance, featuring over 30 landscaped parks, children's play areas, reputable kindergartens, and schools. 

  • 5 Minutes to Park
  • 10 Minutes to Mall of the Emirates
  • 10 Minutes to Dubai Marina
  • 15 Minutes to Downtown Dubai
  • 18 Minutes to Palm Jumeirah 
  • 25 Minutes to Dubai International Airport
